'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Adam Howland LS Non-Hyperdrive Junkyard''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Adam Howland]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet title '''NON-HYPERDRIVE JUNKYARD'''; no Objective is written on a numbered line. Starting location published as [[Tatooine: City Outskirts]] (first written card); Watto's Junkyard / Tatooine sites match a Profit-style junkyard list.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Adam Howland]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Tatooine: City Outskirts]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
